label: Opus 5.5 · agent 2
source: harbor run -p harbor/lightlag-live -a opencode -m anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 --ak version=1.19.5 (Harbor 0.25.0), on the real clock
note: Wrote a 489-line autopilot (it installed numpy for it), tested it against a mock of its own, started the campaign six minutes in and played all six missions, then wrote a closing report. It started its program in the form task 0.1.1 suggested, behind a `cd`, and its shell tool killed the program 120 seconds into the campaign, in mission 3 (docs/lightlag-live.md, "The launch trap"; fixed in 0.1.2). The agent restarted it 9.7 seconds later. uninterrupted/ is the program replayed by lightlag_live.sandbox without the interruption: the same score, mission for mission, so the interruption cost this run nothing. OpenCode exited with code 1 afterwards, which Harbor records as an exception; the campaign and its grade are unaffected. program/ holds the autopilot and the mock as copied out of the agent's container during the campaign.
